newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady in the kerb market at 42.55 to the dollar on Sunday as investors sold the U.S. currency to buy stocks, dealers said.
The rupee remained unchanged as investors sold the U.S. currency to enable them to buy stocks, one dealer said. The rupee was likely to open up on Monday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 6.35 percent.
